summary.text: You can deactivate it by phone or at a CPF Service Centre. Processing takes around three to five working days after identity verification.

details.heading: By phone
details.body: Call 1800-227-1188. From overseas, call +65-6227-1188. Choose your language, then select option ‘8’ during operating hours.

details.heading: At a service centre
details.body: Make an appointment to visit any CPF Service Centre during operating hours.

details.heading: Processing time
details.body: Your request takes around three to five working days after your identity is successfully verified.

steps.name: Choose one way
steps.text: Choose one way to request deactivation: call the CPF hotline, or make an appointment to visit any CPF Service Centre during operating hours.

example_phrasings: How do I deactivate the CPF Safety Switch?
How can I turn off the CPF Safety Switch?
I want to deactivate my CPF Safety Switch

sources.page_title: How do I deactivate the CPF Safety Switch?

quotes.text: You may request to deactivate the CPF Safety Switch through one of the following methods:
Call the CPF hotline at 1800-227-1188 (+65-6227-1188 if calling from overseas) and select option ‘8’ after choosing your language during operating hours
Make an appointment to visit any of the CPF Service Centres during operating hours
Note that your deactivation request will take around three to five working days to process, after we successfully verify your identity.
